name: Good Cable
old_description: GoodCable Inc. is the oldest continuous cable assembly operation serving the greater Colorado Springs area since 1991.
about:
Good Cable, operating as GoodCable Inc., has been based in Colorado Springs, Colorado since its founding in 1991. The company describes itself as the oldest continuous cable assembly operation in the greater Colorado Springs area.

The shop specializes in custom wire harness and cable assembly manufacturing, covering prototyping through low-to-mid-volume production runs. Work is tracked via individual work orders, and the company offers both turnkey and consignment assembly models. Capabilities extend to electro‑mechanical box‑build assembly, with partner relationships for printed circuit board fabrication. Every assembly undergoes electrical and hipot testing with documented results for opens and shorts.

Customers span medical device makers, signage manufacturers (gas‑station and interstate signs), aerospace and defense (including F‑14 bomb‑release harnesses), telecommunications, automotive and motorcycle accessories, theatrical lighting, industrial equipment, and audio/video and computer peripherals. Long‑term clients include Hewlett Packard, Ethicon Endo‑Surgery, Skyline Electric Signs, and Rockwell, alongside smaller prototype‑only customers.

Good Cable’s stated differentiator is a quality guarantee: if a customer is not satisfied with an assembly, the labor and repair are free. The workmanship manual references IPC, ANSI, UE, and CSA standards alongside customer specifications. The company emphasizes decades of staff experience and a “if it’s copper, we’ll build it” breadth of materials from PVC to Teflon.
